heading: How do I reduce a JPG for an upload or email?
introduction: Re-encode your JPG or JPEG photo with a lower-quality or smaller-dimension preset, then compare the result. In Maximum mode, a best-effort target can also try to fit JPG or WebP output below a chosen file size.

sections.heading: Start with a copy of the original
sections.body: Add the photograph and choose Recommended first. Check the result against the upload limit. If it remains too large, try Maximum or its available target-size option, then inspect the downloaded image.

sections.heading: A target size is a limit, not an exact byte count
sections.body: The bounded search tries to produce a file below your threshold. It can report that a target could not be met, and it does not promise an exact number of bytes. A lower target can reduce visible detail.

sections.heading: Where JPG works well
sections.body: JPG suits photographs and many opaque web images. It cannot preserve transparency. Inspect faces, fine textures and lettering, and keep the camera or design original because repeated lossy encoding can add artifacts.

seoTitle: JPG Compressor — Reduce Photo File Size
seoDescription: Reduce JPG and JPEG photo size in your browser. Compare presets or try a best-effort target in Maximum mode. Check quality before replacing originals.
